rules: Do not implement cryptographic primitives inside Worldshepherd application code.
Prefer maintained protocol/library implementations with explicit interoperability tests.
Do not remove classical algorithms until the relevant protocol and counterparties support the migration path.
Treat long-retention confidentiality as higher priority because harvest-now-decrypt-later risk precedes cryptographically relevant quantum computers.
Repository text discovery is not proof of deployed cryptographic configuration; runtime, TLS, SSH, OIDC, secret-store, backup, and release-signing configuration must be inspected separately.

source_discovery_snapshot.interpretation: The source tree contains substantial bearer/API credential handling and hash/provenance logic, but this scan found no operational repository reference to RSA/ECDSA/Ed25519/X25519/DSA/secp256k1/secp256r1 and no private-key material marker. This does not establish the algorithms used by deployed TLS, SSH, OIDC/JWT, backups, Git signing, or external services.
